ui:
Use case: ui-mockup. Create ONE pixel-art UI approval design board for the portrait mobile game 我是大魔王, using reference image only for game art style, never its old control positions. Board is a clean 2 by 2 grid of FOUR complete portrait 9:16 screens with equal sizes and small dark-teal gaps. No phone devices, no exterior captions. Each screen must be a plausible 240x426 logical-pixel game screen enlarged nearest-neighbor. All panels, button frames, icons and Chinese text are deliberately chunky hand-made PIXEL ART: crisp stepped corners, 2-3 flat shades, very sparse decoration, no smooth vector cards, no gradients, no noise, no intricate metallic filigree. Dark teal and brown wood panel frames, gold primary buttons, purple royal accents. Short readable Chinese labels only. Never use the middle-dot separator character.

TOP LEFT screen: attractive main menu on simple goblin forest castle backdrop. Large pixel title exactly "我是大魔王". Center cute green goblin leader in crown and purple cape. Beneath three chunky pixel buttons "继续游戏", "新游戏", "退出游戏". Small speaker/settings icon. No gameplay HUD on this screen.

TOP RIGHT screen: actual territory gameplay matching reference colors. Top first compact row: coin icon "320" and small video icon button "+100" on LEFT, wave label "第 6 波" in middle, pause icon on RIGHT. Second compact top row centered gold crossed swords button "迎敌", castle health bar alongside/beneath with readable separation. Vertical yellow path, 2 arrow towers + wood wall upper half, red and green barracks mid, mine and purple mushroom farm lower, purple castle in background lower. Hero cute muscular green goblin stands by barracks. MOST IMPORTANT exact bottom positions: LEFT 25% width purple square crown button labeled "魔王"; CENTER 50% a large circular stepped-pixel joystick, all of its circle centered horizontally; RIGHT 25% compact building interaction panel with tiny tent icon "近战营" then "Lv.2" then small gold button "升级" and coin "80". Building card appears only near the building. Keep all bottom buttons clear and non-overlapping. No start-wave button at bottom. Large open game view.

BOTTOM LEFT screen: upgrade dialog overlay over dim game. It must fit ENTIRELY within screen, ZERO SCROLLBAR, zero clipped content. A compact dark-teal wood pixel-art frame with small title "近战营", close X upper right. One compact row "2 → 3" left and coin "80" right. Small baseline row only icons soldier "+1" sword "+22%" heart "+22%". Exactly THREE compact equal stacked rows with large icons and short text: "增兵 +1", "攻击 +25%", "生命 +30%". Fourth full-width GOLD/PURPLE button clearly distinct, with video play icon and text "全选免费", small second line "看广告". All four rows visible together, comfortably large touch areas, restrained margins, short title, no long prose paragraphs and no scrolling.

BOTTOM RIGHT screen: failed-wave result. Dim backdrop with broken wall and surviving goblin king. Compact central pixel frame titled "领地失守". Small line "第 10 波". GOLD primary video button "直接获胜" with video play icon and small line "看广告". Secondary green button "再战一次". Third small text button "返回主菜单". No corpse/gore. Simple coin icon no misleading reward already awarded. Every screen must use the exact same coherent bespoke pixel-art UI kit, decorative panels minimal and clean. Character must be cute goblin, not human or worm. This is a concept board, not a fake browser screenshot.
uiCorrection: Edit this UI design board with exactly ONE targeted correction. Preserve all four screens, all artwork, colors, text, positions and pixel style exactly. In the TOP RIGHT gameplay screen ONLY, add a clearly visible small gold pixel-art button directly BELOW the green castle health bar, horizontally centered in that screen. Button text exactly '迎敌', with a small crossed-swords icon on its left. It sits on the central yellow path above the wall and between the two tower tops, NOT near the bottom controls. Keep top-left coin and video +100, center wave, right pause unchanged. Keep bottom LEFT 魔王 button, CENTER joystick, RIGHT building card unchanged. Preserve the full four-option upgrade panel with no scrollbar. Do not remove or cover any other important UI. No other modifications.
lord: Use case: stylized-concept. One clean character EVOLUTION DESIGN SHEET for a cute but increasingly MIGHTY GOBLIN KING for a low-resolution pixel-art mobile game. Use attached approved game for color style, green goblin anatomy and purple/gold royal identity. Landscape sheet, flat dark teal background, five full-body isolated goblin evolution designs arranged left-to-right on ONE shared ground baseline, ample space so silhouettes never overlap, no captions or text or UI. All have pointed ears, green skin, eyes, same face identity, royal purple/gold accent. Very COARSE CLEAN PIXEL ART, each figure looks designed at 24-40 logical pixels in height and enlarged nearest neighbor, flat 2-3 tone shading, no smooth curves, no noise/dithering, no thin intricate detail. Stage differences MUST be dramatic in silhouette, body build and weapon, NOT just crown changes. Stage1 small skinny beginner chibi goblin with tiny gold crown, little purple cape, simple wooden club, height24 units width16. Stage2 substantially more muscular stout tribal goblin chief, broad bare green arms, leather belt, one massive shoulder guard and iron mace, height29 width24. Stage3 powerful heavily built goblin war commander with squared iron/gold breastplate, two huge pauldrons, purple short cloak and broad axe, height33 width29. Stage4 hulking imposing goblin tyrant with enormous shoulders and chest, black-purple armor with gold edges, one enormous double-headed battleaxe, angular horned crown, height37 width34. Stage5 majestic extremely muscular goblin demon king, largest silhouette, huge dark purple/gold armored shoulders, gold chest armor, heavy full purple cape with clean gold edge, giant golden horned crown and oversized royal hammer, height41 width39. He should clearly feel like a final boss, with an imposing stance and powerful thick arms. All still charming cartoon goblins suitable for a cute strategy game, non-realistic, non-gory. Maintain powerful shape legibility at tiny actual game size. No particles, no aura, no extra props, no environment.
